top.name: a(n) is the maximum number of distinct distances possible between points in a hyperrectangular grid the sum of whose dimensions is n.
Triangular numbers: a(n) = binomial(n+1,2) = n*(n+1)/2 = 0 + 1 + 2 + ... + n.
Central polygonal numbers: a(n) = n^2 - n + 1.
Padovan sequence (or Padovan numbers): a(n) = a(n-2) + a(n-3) with a(0) = 1, a(1) = a(2) = 0.
